== Title ==

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">任意の星系カードに配備する。相手の宇宙船１隻を対象に選ぶ。対象は戦闘力＝０、没収＝０となる。対象がこのカードと同じ場所に移動したなら、相手は運命数を引く。運命数＞２なら、このカードはキャンセルされる。そうでなければ、次の移動フェイズにもう一度運命数を引く。</span>

The source frame cuts off the bottom edge of the text box.<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-222o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">宇宙船は時として、戦闘でダメージを受け、修理と補給を受けるまで使用不能となる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Card text:''' Deploy on any system. Target one opposing starship. The target's power and forfeit become 0. When it moves to the same location as this card, your opponent draws destiny. If it exceeds 2, cancel this card. Otherwise, draw again on the next move phase.

'''Lore:''' Starships can take damage in combat and remain unusable until repaired and resupplied.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 4
* '''Printed subtype:''' Utinni Effect

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
